title: MaleTheme Duo #032 · 남 클래식 머슬·에메랄드 라인·해적 테마 / 남 피트니스 모델·블루 라인·악마 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit white-washed courtyard with a pale tiled floor, an arched doorway at normal height, low stone steps and a waist-high wall, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Egyptian man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful idol face with a small V-line jaw, bright expressive eyes and a straight nose, clean-shaven, bold emerald-green eyeliner with a sheer burgundy-stained lip, smooth warm light-brown skin, a soft amused smile, soft pastel-peach hair styled in cornrows braided tight against the scalp, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large bronze hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a gold round bell, a silver hammer head, a gold barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long bronze chain ending in one large faceted emerald drop with a heavy rough bronze a barrel-shaped weight hanging at its end, and seven to ten heavily stacked platinum necklaces. Extremely long oval nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful, classically muscular man, far beyond any real person, in the shape of a Greek statue. Wide shoulders, a full defined chest, a clean six-pack abdomen, strong rounded arms, and muscular thighs and calves, balanced and proportionate from head to toe, powerful and enormous. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a black tricorn pirate hat with a white skull emblem, a red bandana knotted at his neck, black leather wrist cuffs with gold studs, and a minimal black leather with gold buckles T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.
LEFT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme white thigh-high stiletto boots with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Ethiopian man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty androgynous idol face with large doe eyes, a small chin and a soft jaw, clean-shaven, graphic electric-blue eyeliner extended into bold wings, smooth medium-brown skin with a warm red undertone, a playful half-grin, warm honey-blonde hair styled in braided, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large gold hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (an iron miniature anvil, an iron teardrop-shaped sinker, a gold square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked silver rings. RIGHT Physique: A tall, extraordinarily well-built athletic man, far beyond any real person in size, built like a fitness model. Broad shoulders, a full athletic chest, a lean defined abdomen with a clear eight-pack, strong toned arms, a narrow waist, and long strong toned legs with defined calves. Large and powerful in frame, yet taut, lean and elegant rather than bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a pair of small curved black horns on his head, a thin pointed devil tail, a black leather collar, and a minimal glossy black leather T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.
RIGHT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme black plain stiletto pumps with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
